US: Legislators Introduce Bill to Find Common Definition of Blockchain Technology

Blockchain is a technology that allows the storage and transmission of digital data. Thanks to a register containing each movement and metadata of these movements, this technology makes it possible to perfectly know the origin of the data circulating.

It is sometimes compared to an open ledger that everyone could consult but from which no one could delete a line or tear off a page.

Each time a new transaction is made, its metadata is stored in a block that is linked to the rest of the blocks containing information about previous transactions. These blocks linked to each other in chronological order form a chain: the block chain or blockchain in English.

The blockchain could revolutionize the monetary system because it no longer requires the intervention of a banking structure. With digital currencies that use blockchain technology, it is possible to make transactions directly from private individual to private individual without intermediaries. No need for a banker, an administration that notes and stores all the information concerning your monetary exchanges. All this information will be included in the blocks of the chain. Encrypted currency is in a way its own banking administration.
